entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Madras

sentences.text:
For Petitioner : Mr.S.Sugendran
 Additional Public Prosec
 Order
This Suo Motu Case is dealt with in an extraordinary manner by the Dedicated Bench, pursuant to Suo Motu W.P.(Crl.) No.618 of 2025.
2. The case, Cr.No.92 of 2019 was registered for an alleged offence under Sections 486, 420 of IPC and Sections 51 (b) (i), 63 (a) of the Copyright Act, 1957.
The occurrence is of the year 2019.
The allegation in this case is that the accused was found to be in possession of fake shorts of Puma Company, without any Trade Mark Registration documents.
There is no subsequent previous case against the accused.
The case is pending at the stage of summons.

3. Considering the factual matrix, context of the case, the antecedents of the accused, the reason for absence from his usual place, and the submission that, despite best efforts, the summons could not be served, it is evident that even if the accused is brought to face trial, it would impinge upon his right to speedy trial.
Due to the passage of time, no meaningful trial is likely to be taken place and no useful purpose would be served.

Jer 4.
Accordingly, the CC.No.370 of 2019 on the file of the District Munsif Cum Judicial Magistrate Court, Uthukuli, Tiruppur, stands quashed and the Suo Motu Transfer Case stands disposed of.
